description: OpenAI Responses streaming: the reader (readResponsesStream in lib/openai-responses-api.mjs, over lib/sse.mjs): what is shown as text, which events end a stream, and that a stream without its terminal event is no answer.

mutations.name: RS1
mutations.what: a response with no body is read as a stream

patches.old: if(!body||typeof body.getReader!=='function')throw fail('invalid_responses_stream','Provider returned no SSE stream.');

mutations.name: RS2
mutations.what: a [DONE] line is read as an event

mutations.name: RS3
mutations.what: an event that is not an object is read

mutations.name: RS4
mutations.what: the arguments of a call are shown as text

mutations.name: RS5
mutations.what: the text is not shown while it streams

mutations.name: RS6
mutations.what: an incomplete response is not a terminal event

mutations.name: RS7
mutations.what: a failed response is not a terminal event

mutations.name: RS8
mutations.what: a cancelled response is not a terminal event

mutations.name: RS9
mutations.what: a completed response is not a terminal event

mutations.name: RS10
mutations.what: a second terminal event is accepted

mutations.name: RS11
mutations.what: the terminal event itself is the response

mutations.name: RS12
mutations.what: a stream that ends without its terminal event gives no error

patches.old: if(!terminal)throw fail('responses_stream_interrupted','Responses stream ended without terminal confirmation. No tool calls executed.');
